title: Data, storage and vector stores
description: Pick the AWS service that stores, prepares or searches the data behind Cairnway's ML and RAG systems.

cards.prompt: Keep millions of product photos and the RAG source documents in cheap, durable object storage.
Run fast vector similarity search over product-description embeddings, alongside keyword search.
Add embeddings to the PostgreSQL-compatible database the shop already runs, using the pgvector extension.
Run SQL analytics over years of order history in a managed data warehouse.
Discover the shop's data sets, catalog them and run serverless ETL jobs to transform them.
Let a data analyst clean and normalize the returns spreadsheet with a visual, no-code tool.
Check the training data against rules such as 'no missing prices' and get a data quality score.
Run Apache Spark jobs on a managed cluster to process terabytes of clickstream data.
Subscribe to a third-party weather data set to improve the demand forecast.
Store shopping-cart sessions in a serverless key-value database with single-digit-millisecond reads.
Archive five-year-old training data sets cheaply for compliance, where retrieval can be slow.
Store embeddings in a graph database that models how products, brands and customers relate.
Build a secure data lake on S3 with one place to manage who can see which tables.
